rule_or_requirement: The actual local ZIP must retain valid completion and lap-time gains under the submission-shaped runtime contract.
observable_information: Only rendered frames enter each extracted ZIP agent; paired track and seed identities, finish flag, lap time, invalid action count and runtime resource measurements are recorded.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Run the frozen control and candidate ZIPs locally on twelve new confirmation cells without updating weights, thresholds, sources, or archives.
expected_success_endpoint: Candidate completion count exceeds control, or ties with lower median finished lap time, with no contract violation or candidate-only nonfinish.
falsifier: Candidate-only nonfinish, lower completion count, non-improving median on a tie, invalid action, archive mismatch, or local runtime limit failure.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Twelve paired fresh confirmation cells: tracks 1-3, seeds 336-339, two exact ZIPs.
resource_and_risk_gate: One local registered 1800-second diagnostic; 24 episodes maximum, no external site action, no model confirmation or submission.
